'''Ohma-D'un''', also known as the '''Water Moon''', was the largest [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], following their newfound alliance with the [[Human/Legends|Human]] people of Naboo, the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] established a settlement on Ohma-D'un, bringing multiple specimens of vegetal and animal life to populate the otherwise uninhabited moon. Ten years later, in the early days of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] used a [[Swamp gas|gas weapon]] on the moon, killing many of the Gungan colonists in the process.

==History==
Ohma-D'un was settled by [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] shortly after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] sent [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Queen Amidala]], [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] prior to the arrival of the Gungans. Obi-Wan and Amidala were to set up a stable ecosystem that could support a Gungan [[City/Legends|city]], aided by [[Kharl Vanneb]], [[Sakme Kelene]], [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Hallem Celaar]], as well as several former members of the [[Naboo Underground]],<ref name="Peril in the Ionosphere">{{GamerCite|1|Peril in the Ionosphere}}</ref> including [[Toba]].<ref name="Meet Toba: Soldier and Scout">{{Wizards|url=starwars/article.asp?x=sw20010308a&c=rpg|text=Meet Toba: Soldier and Scout}}</ref> Amidala and Obi-Wan went to the moon in a [[Mantaris-class amphibious medium transport|''Mantaris''-class amphibious medium transport]] and were given a sacred animal called the [[Kresch]], which acted as a field guide to wildlife. The Gungans packed the transport with many different types of Naboo animals and plants to populate the moon, such as [[Saw-toothed grank]]s, [[tusk cat]]s, [[Shaak/Legends|shaaks]], and [[Kaadu/Legends|kaadu]].<ref name="SWE1:TGF">[[Star Wars Episode I: The Gungan Frontier|''Star Wars'' Episode I: ''The Gungan Frontier'']]</ref> [[Human/Legends|Humans]] also established [[Spice/Legends|spice]] mines on the moon.

It was where the [[Battle of Ohma-D'un|defense of Naboo]] was fought during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="SWR:TNFOW">''[[Star Wars: Republic: The New Face of War]]''</ref> resulting in almost the entire Gungan colony being wiped out by a [[Swamp gas|poison gas]] developed by [[Jenna Zan Arbor]].

[[Victor Flight]] of the [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps/Legends|Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps]] often made runs out to the moon.<ref name="GMR">{{GamerCite|9|On Wings of Rogues}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Mesa sendin' them to Ohma-D'un.|Boss Nass in possible dialogue in ''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds''|audio=Ohma-DunNamedrop.flac|<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>}}
The moon was called "Ohma'Dun" in ''[[On Wings of Rogues]]''. ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' uses a depiction of the moon seen in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] for its entry on Ohma-D'un, however its depiction as a lifeless-looking moon without an apparent atmosphere contradicts its more lush appearance in ''[[Star Wars Episode I: The Gungan Frontier]]''.

In the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'', optional dialogue from Boss Nass may mention sending enemies to Ohma-D'un.<ref name="GB" />
